interpretations.description: Observed windows combine a high auction-location value with current volume above the explicit causal baseline across both fixture assets.
interpretations.candidate_mechanism_inference: Inference: the joint configuration may reflect a recurring high-location auction condition with above-baseline observed volume, without identifying its cause.
interpretations.falsifiable_hypothesis: On untouched Phase 5 data, events assigned to this frozen detector will have a different distribution of 15-minute forward returns and realized volatility than time-matched negative controls.
spuriousness_reasons: Fixture separation is synthetic and unusually strong.
Transition support contains only two dwell-run events.
Two assets may not represent broader market conditions.
OHLCV-derived auction location is an approximation.
